headline: NNPC Considers 5% to 10% Stake Sale in Planned IPO
summary: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited is considering selling between 5% and 10% of its equity through an initial public offering, with the proposed listing expected to focus on Nigeria's domestic capital market.
why: NNPC is Nigeria's state-owned oil corporation, and an IPO would represent a landmark privatization event aiming to deepen domestic capital markets and mobilize investment.

impacts.name: Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation
impacts.why: An equity sale via IPO alters corporate ownership structure and raises capital from public markets.
